gen.orderNote: Follow the triangles in order as the sides grow and watch the ratio

steps.label: same angle b
steps.quote: All of the triangles are right triangles, and all have the same angle b at the lower left corner.

steps.label: For the black triangle, the cosine
steps.quote: For the black triangle, the cosine of “b” is equal to x divided by y.

steps.label: red triangle
steps.quote: Now let us consider the red triangle. It was formed by doubling the size of sides of the black triangle.

steps.label: For the red triangle, the cosine
steps.quote: For the red triangle, the cosine of “b” is equal to 2x divided by 2y.

steps.label: blue triangle
steps.quote: Finally, let us consider the blue triangle. It was formed by tripling the size of sides of the black triangle.

steps.label: cosine “b” just depends
steps.quote: The value of cosine “b” just depends on the value of “b” and not the length of the sides that form “b”.
